nodes.name: 011_observability.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the rag_traces observability table capturing per-query RAG metrics (retrieval latency, token usage, hallucination flags, slow queries) with four targeted partial indexes for analytics queries.

nodes.name: rag_traces
nodes.summary: RAG observability traces table recording per-query performance, token counts, similarity scores, and quality signals (refusals, hallucinations, slow responses) scoped to project and session.

nodes.name: 012_add_project_member_roles.sql
nodes.summary: Adds a project-level role column (member/admin) to project_members enabling fine-grained per-project admin delegation without requiring global admin rights.

nodes.name: 013_project_announcements.sql
nodes.summary: Creates the project_announcements table enabling admins to broadcast titled messages to project members, with an index on project and creation time.

nodes.name: project_announcements
nodes.summary: Project-scoped announcement messages with title, body, sender reference, and creation timestamp.

nodes.name: 014_learning_feedback_features.sql
nodes.summary: Creates quiz_coaching_plans and chat_answer_feedback tables for AI-generated coaching recommendations and user feedback on chat responses, plus three supporting indexes.

nodes.name: 015_document_chunks_fts.sql
nodes.summary: Adds full-text search capability to document_chunks by introducing a tsvector search_vector column maintained by a PL/pgSQL trigger, with a GIN index for fast keyword search.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE trigger with to_tsvector('english', ...) to auto-maintain the search_vector column; backfills existing rows in-place.

nodes.name: 016_document_threads.sql
nodes.summary: Creates document_threads and document_thread_comments tables for collaborative Q&A discussions on specific documents, with status tracking and three performance indexes.

nodes.name: document_threads
nodes.summary: Threaded discussions on documents with page number scoping, status lifecycle (open/resolved), and resolver tracking.

nodes.name: document_thread_comments
nodes.summary: Individual comment entries within document threads, supporting answer flagging and author attribution.

nodes.name: 017_flashcards_spaced_repetition.sql
nodes.summary: Creates flashcards and flashcard_progress tables implementing spaced repetition learning (SM-2 algorithm parameters: interval_days, ease_factor, repetitions, due_at) linked to document chunks.
nodes.languageNotes: Stores SM-2 spaced repetition parameters (ease_factor, interval_days, repetitions, due_at) enabling adaptive review scheduling.

nodes.name: flashcards
nodes.summary: AI-generated flashcard question/answer pairs derived from document chunks with difficulty metadata.

nodes.name: flashcard_progress
nodes.summary: Per-user spaced repetition progress tracking for each flashcard with SM-2 scheduling parameters and due dates.

nodes.name: 018_quiz_attempt_history.sql
nodes.summary: Creates quiz_attempt_history table to preserve historical quiz scores before admin resets, enabling audit trails with reset reason and actor.

nodes.name: quiz_attempt_history
nodes.summary: Immutable historical record of quiz attempt scores at the time of an admin reset, preserving pass/fail status and reset attribution.

nodes.name: 019_document_connectors.sql
nodes.summary: Creates document_connectors table and adds source tracking columns to documents for external integrations (Confluence, SharePoint), enabling automated document sync from third-party providers.

nodes.name: document_connectors
nodes.summary: Configuration registry for external document provider integrations (Confluence, SharePoint) with sync status tracking and encrypted credentials storage.

nodes.name: 020_auth_provider.sql
nodes.summary: Adds auth_provider column to users to distinguish credential-based from Cognito-provisioned accounts, preventing cross-provider login conflicts with a backfill for existing Cognito rows.

nodes.name: 021_password_reset_tokens.sql
nodes.summary: Creates password_reset_tokens table storing time-limited email-scoped tokens for the credentials-based password reset flow.

nodes.name: password_reset_tokens
nodes.summary: Time-limited password reset tokens keyed by email with expiration timestamps for secure credential recovery.

nodes.name: 022_quiz_retake_requests.sql
nodes.summary: Creates quiz_retake_requests table allowing members to formally request quiz retake approval from admins, with status lifecycle and resolution tracking.

nodes.name: quiz_retake_requests
nodes.summary: Member-initiated retake requests linked to quiz attempts with admin approval workflow (pending/approved/denied) and resolution timestamps.

nodes.name: 023_multi_provider_email.sql
nodes.summary: Replaces the single-column UNIQUE (email) constraint on users with a composite UNIQUE (email, auth_provider) constraint to allow the same email across different auth providers.

nodes.name: 024_knowledge_gap_threads.sql
nodes.summary: Extends document_threads to support knowledge-gap discussions (no document required) by making document_id nullable and adding source type and gap_query columns.

nodes.name: 025_bot_thread_replies.sql
nodes.summary: Adds bot_thread_reply job type to processing_jobs type constraint and adds is_bot flag to document_thread_comments to identify AI-generated replies.
